name: What Remains
source:
In winter, a season which should be filled with joy and splendour, three lost souls remain in a lodge in the midst of the unknown.Confronted with their past, they must now cope with a stranger who calls into question not only their own convictions, but their entire existence. 

The player takes on the role of an inspector tasked with determining whether a worker, a banker, and a journalist are aware of their own misdemeanors. They may not, however, be the only ones to bear the consequences of their own actions.

[From [url=https://falltraveler.itch.io/what-remains]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
冬天，一个本应充满欢乐和辉煌的季节，三个迷失的灵魂留在了未知的小屋里。面对他们的过去，他们现在必须面对一个陌生人，这个陌生人不仅质疑他们自己的信念，而且质疑他们的整个存在。

玩家扮演一名检查员的角色，负责确定一名工人、一名银行家和一名记者是否意识到自己的轻罪。然而，他们可能不是唯一要为自己的行为承担后果的人。

[来自[url=https://falltraveler.itch.io/what-remains]Itch.io[/url]]
